copy.tagline: 遵循 React 和 TSX 开发标准，提升代码质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 React 和 TypeScript 开发，需要统一标准和工具
copy.tagline_en: Follow React and TSX development standards to improve code quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop with React and TypeScript and need consistent standards and tooling

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 React 和 TSX 的编码规范来生成代码，例如使用函数组件、显式类型化 props、合理使用 Hooks，并优先采用组合而非属性传递。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 编写或修改 React/TSX 代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 React 函数组件，props 用 interface 定义。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合 TSX 标准的组件。

say.text: 给这个 useState 加上类型，用户可能为 null。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate code following React and TSX development standards, such as using functional components, explicitly typing props, properly typing hooks, and preferring composition over prop drilling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write or modify React/TSX code.

say_en.text: Write a React functional component with props defined using interface.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a standards-compliant component.

say_en.text: Add a type to this useState, user could be null.
say_en.note: Claude will explicitly type the hook.
